description: Extract the original user input for result/error presentation prompts. Returns only original_input and flow_id (excludes attachments to prevent confusion between input attachments and output attachment refs).

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Original user input for presentation (excludes attachments)
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Extracting original user input for result/error presentation
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError with 'flow_id': no flow record exists with the specified ID. DatabaseError: failed to query flow record.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For not found errors: verify the flow_id is correct. For database errors: verify database connectivity and retry.
